# assay: `AssayOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze assay wells|curve|dose-response|kinetics|growth|qc FILE --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

`openreadout analyze assay … --json` data.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/assay.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/assay.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema assay`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input (`plate`, or `long-csv`). |
| `analysis` | `string` | yes | The analysis run (`wells`, `curve`, `dose-response`, `kinetics`, `growth`, `qc`). |
| `table` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Table (plate) index. |
| `plate` | `string` or `null` |  | Plate (table) name. |
| `read` | [`ReadSummary`](#readsummary) | yes | The read analysed. |
| `reduce` | `string` or `null` |  | How kinetic time courses were reduced to one value per well (endpoint analyses). |
| `layout` | [`LayoutSummary`](#layoutsummary) | yes | Where the layout came from and what it assigns. |
| `blank` | [`BlankSummary`](#blanksummary) or `null` |  | Blank subtraction applied. |
| `outliers` | [`OutlierSummary`](#outliersummary) | yes | Outlier rule and flagged wells. |
| `wells` | array of [`WellRow`](#wellrow) |  | One row per well. |
| `samples` | array of [`SampleRow`](#samplerow) |  | One row per replicate group (sample, standard level, control, dose). |
| `curve` | [`CurveReport`](#curvereport) or `null` |  | Standard-curve fit report (`curve`). |
| `compounds` | array of [`CompoundRow`](#compoundrow) |  | One row per compound (`dose-response`). |
| `kinetics` | array of [`KineticRow`](#kineticrow) |  | One row per well (`kinetics`). |
| `growth` | array of [`GrowthRow`](#growthrow) |  | One row per well (`growth`). |
| `quality` | [`QualityReport`](#qualityreport) or `null` |  | Assay quality from control wells (whenever positive and negative controls exist). |
| `written` | array of `string` |  | Files written (`--csv`, `--preview`). |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | What was assumed or left out. |
| `warnings` | array of `string` |  | What may be wrong with the layout: role names read as samples, controls of unknown sign, role-map entries that matched no well. |

## Types

### ReadSummary

The read analysed.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `number` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | 1-based read number. |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Label as the file writes it. |
| `mode` | `string` or `null` |  | Detection mode. |
| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit of the values. |
| `calculated` | `boolean` |  | Values the vendor software calculated (not measured). |
| `kinetic` | `boolean` | yes | Whether the read has several time points per well. |
| `time_points` | `integer` (uint) or `null` |  | Time points per well (kinetic reads). |
| `wavelength_nm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The wavelength selected (spectral reads). |
| `wells_measured` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Wells with values. |

### LayoutSummary

Layout summary.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` | array of `string` | yes | Sources merged, in order (later ones win well by well): `embedded:<title>`, a file path, `text`, `--blank`, …. |
| `wells_assigned` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Measured wells with a role. |
| `roles` | object: string → `integer` (uint) | yes | Measured wells per role (`unassigned` for wells the layout does not name). |
| `concentration_unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit of the concentrations, when the layout states one. |

### BlankSummary

Blank subtraction applied.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | `string` | yes | `mean` or `median`. |
| `wells` | array of `string` | yes | Blank wells used. |
| `n` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Number of blank wells used. |
| `value` | `number` (double) | yes | The value subtracted (endpoint), or its mean over time points (kinetic: subtracted per time point). |
| `sd` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | SD of the blank wells (endpoint). |
| `per_time_point` | `boolean` |  | Whether the blank was subtracted per time point. |

### OutlierSummary

Outlier rule and result.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rule` | `string` | yes | `mad`, `grubbs` or `none`. |
| `threshold` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Modified z-score cut-off (mad) or alpha (grubbs). |
| `flagged` | array of `string` | yes | Wells flagged. |
| `excluded` | `boolean` | yes | Whether flagged wells were left out of means, fits and controls. |

### WellRow

One well.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `well` | `string` | yes | Well name (`A1`). |
| `row` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | 1-based row. |
| `col` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | 1-based column. |
| `role` | `string` | yes | Role (`blank`, `standard`, `sample`, `positive`, `negative`, `control`, `empty`), or `unassigned`. |
| `group` | `string` | yes | Replicate group this well belongs to. |
| `sample` | `string` or `null` |  | Sample name. |
| `compound` | `string` or `null` |  | Compound. |
| `concentration` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Nominal concentration (standards, doses). |
| `dilution` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Dilution factor. |
| `raw` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The value as read (after `reduce` for kinetic reads); null when the cell was not a number. |
| `value` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | After blank subtraction (equal to `raw` without one). |
| `outlier` | `boolean` | yes | Flagged as an outlier in its replicate group. |
| `excluded` | `boolean` | yes | Left out of means and fits. |
| `back_calculated` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Concentration back-calculated from the standard curve (`curve`). |
| `final_concentration` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | `back_calculated` × `dilution`. |
| `flag` | `string` or `null` |  | `curve`: `in_range`, `below_range`, `above_range` (outside the standards' concentrations), `below_curve`, `above_curve` (beyond an asymptote: no concentration) or `not_computable`. |
| `quantifiable` | `boolean` or `null` |  | `curve`: within [LLOQ, ULOQ]. |
| `recovery_percent` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Standards: back-calculated / nominal × 100. |
| `percent_effect` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | `dose-response` with `normalize: controls`: percent effect. |
| `extra` | object: string → `string` |  | Other layout columns. |

### SampleRow

One replicate group.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `n` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Wells in the group. |
| `n_used` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Wells used (numbers, not excluded). |

| `cv_percent` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | SD / |mean| × 100. |

| `back_calculated_of_mean` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | `curve`: concentration back-calculated from the group's mean signal. |
| `final_concentration` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | `back_calculated_mean` × dilution. |
| `flag` | `string` or `null` |  | `curve`: range flag of `back_calculated_of_mean`. |
| `recovery_percent` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Standards: `back_calculated_mean` / nominal × 100. |

| field | type | always present | description |

| field | type | always present | description |

Growth metrics of one well.

| field | type | always present | description |

### QualityReport

Assay quality of the plate (values as read, before blank subtraction).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `positive` | [`GroupStats`](#groupstats) or `null` |  | Positive-control wells. |
| `negative` | [`GroupStats`](#groupstats) or `null` |  | Negative-control wells. |
| `blank` | [`GroupStats`](#groupstats) or `null` |  | Blank wells. |
| `samples` | [`GroupStats`](#groupstats) or `null` |  | Sample wells. |
| `z_prime` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Z′ = 1 − 3 (SDpos + SDneg) / |mean pos − mean neg| (Zhang, Chung & Oldenburg 1999). |
| `z_factor` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Z = 1 − 3 (SDsamples + SDneg) / |mean samples − mean neg|. |
| `signal_to_background` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Higher control mean / lower control mean. |
| `signal_to_noise` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | |mean pos − mean neg| / SDneg. |
| `ssmd` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Strictly standardized mean difference (mean pos − mean neg) / √(SDpos² + SDneg²). |
| `median_replicate_cv_percent` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median CV % over replicate groups of two or more wells. |
| `assessment` | `string` or `null` |  | `excellent` (Z′ ≥ 0.5), `marginal` (0 < Z′ < 0.5) or `unusable` (Z′ ≤ 0). |
